item: the columnar job names tests/test_external_freshness.py, whose one DuckDB test returned early in every job
summary: tests/test_external_freshness.py::test_duckdb_version_coupling_holds_when_installed returns early when duckdb is not importable, and no job that installs duckdb ran the file, so the check that the installed duckdb meets the registered floor (the coupling the bundled httpfs extension and the storage format depend on) passed vacuously in every job that ran the file (test, Core-only, the urllib3 floor, the SQLCipher engines, portability) and never ran against a real duckdb in CI. The columnar job's first pytest step now names the file after the 28 files #1654 listed, so the check runs against the duckdb the job resolves. Measured with scratch installs on the fresh main tip: the 29-file step passes 472 with 2 skips on duckdb 1.5.6 (66.6 s) and 471 with 3 skips on duckdb 2.0.0 (72.7 s); the file adds 15 tests and about 7 s, fourteen of them registry checks that also run in the test job. Stated limits: the ratchet (tests/test_skipped_tests_have_a_ci_job_that_runs_them.py) does not see this file until Q's follow-on makes the test an importorskip and teaches the checker the _duckdb_minor gate, so until then dropping the name from the step stays green; the runner's own figure for the added seconds is not measured here.
